heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
For compensation for the breach of any contract, express or implied not herein specially provided for.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the contract is broken or (where there are successive breaches) when the breach in respect of which the suit is instituted occurs or (where the breach is continuing) when it ceases.
